evals.prompt: Create implementation-ready specs for an enterprise runtime with adapters, queues, policy, observability, sandboxed tools, and user-facing workflows.
evals.expected_output: Creates business-to-technical layered specs with shared sources of truth, contracts, flows, UX/frontend behavior, NFRs, diagrams only where useful, readiness report, and planning evidence.

evals.prompt: Review specs for enterprise gaps, repetition, unclear structure, and happy-path-only behavior.
evals.expected_output: Finds missing structure, source-of-truth links, unhappy paths, timeouts, retries, cleanup, recovery, security/privacy, observability, performance, tests, and readiness gaps.
